query: For September 2026, what are total route revenue and operating income from route monthly P&L?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue, SUM(operating_income) AS operating_income FROM wisdomai.ZAL_VW_ROUTE_PNL_MONTHLY WHERE month_end_date=DATE '2026-09-30'
assertions: ["Revenue is 64612818.33 and operating income is 6860708.98 in source monetary units."]

query: For September 2026, how many scheduled flights, cancellations and diversions were recorded?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS scheduled_flights, SUM(CASE WHEN cancelled_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancellations, SUM(CASE WHEN diverted_flag=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diversions FROM wisdomai.ZAL_VW_FLIGHT WHERE flight_date>=DATE '2026-09-01' AND flight_date<DATE '2026-10-01'

query: For September 2026 on survey date, how many survey responses, promoters and detractors were recorded?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS responses, SUM(CASE WHEN nps_score BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS promoters, SUM(CASE WHEN nps_score BETWEEN 0 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detractors FROM wisdomai.ZAL_VW_PASSENGER_SURVEY WHERE survey_date>=DATE '2026-09-01' AND survey_date<DATE '2026-10-01'

query: What is the count of synthetic workshop notes by scenario?
sql: SELECT scenario, COUNT(*) AS note_count FROM wisdom_storage.WORKSHOP_SYNTHETIC_service_notes WHERE synthetic_flag=1 GROUP BY scenario
assertions: ["8 total notes: baggage 2, service 2, accessibility 1, cabin 1, weather 1, wifi 1. Clearly identifies teaching data."]
